source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Being relevant mainly for clients who have a fairly mild form of COPD, rather than for clients across the full spectrum of disease severity","B":"Taking the place of the ongoing provider follow-up the client would otherwise still need to attend on a regular basis","C":"Guide the client in recognizing worsening symptoms and taking appropriate, timely action, potentially reducing exacerbation severity or need for emergency care","D":"Resting on fairly little established evidence of benefit despite being a commonly recommended self-management tool for clients with COPD"}}
source_row.rationale: An individualized COPD action plan helps guide the client in recognizing worsening symptoms and taking appropriate, timely action (such as adjusting medications or contacting the provider), potentially reducing exacerbation severity or the need for emergency care, valuable across a range of COPD severity.
source_row.source_detail: Purpose of Individualized COPD Action Plans
source_row.stem: A nurse provides a client with COPD an individualized action plan, outlining specific steps to take based on symptom severity. This tool helps:
